description: 4 exemplars (1 de) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Exemplars ask for a data-classification, retention, transfer or DSR judgement. Near-misses share the privacy vocabulary and route elsewhere: a regulatory-regime read of a feature (privacy-review), raw identifiers in a log line (domain-safety-pii territory, via logging-monitoring), and a data-processing agreement redline (dpa-review). Counterexamples guard 'keep' and 'transfer' in unrelated senses.

queries.q: how long do we keep support tickets and their attachments after the case is closed?
can we send our EU customer records to an analytics vendor hosted in the US?
classify these columns in the users table by sensitivity so we know what needs encryption
wie bauen wir einen Ablauf für DSGVO-Auskunfts- und Löschanfragen auf?
run a privacy review of the new referral feature before launch
queries.note: a regulatory-regime read of a feature, not a data-handling judgement → privacy-review

queries.q: our logger writes the full request body including emails — make it log only user ids
redline this data processing agreement from our vendor
keep the sidebar open when the user navigates between pages
transfer the domain to the new registrar
queries.note: 'transfer' of a domain, not of data
